summary: Change serializes Enum by .name instead of .value, matching Django's actual accepted fix for this issue; it correctly makes migrations stable under translated/mutable enum values. Approach is sound and minimal.

issues.description: Edge case: enum members that are aliases (duplicate values) or Enums whose name differs semantically are handled fine by name lookup, but Flags/IntFlag combined values (e.g. FlagA|FlagB) have no single .name and would serialize to None — a rare corner not covered here, later addressed by a separate EnumSerializer path.
